node.statement: Rectification bounds before and after normalization: the approximate-unit axioms give ||d_L(y)||<=epsilon_X||y||, ||d_R(x)||<=epsilon_X||x||, and ||h||<=epsilon_X a; with ||phi||<=1/a this implies ||m_0(x,y)-xy||<=3 epsilon_X/a ||x||||y||. Since |a-1|<=epsilon_X and ||xy||<=(1+epsilon_X)||x||||y||, Delta=a m_0-m obeys ||Delta(x,y)||<=(3 epsilon_X+epsilon_X(1+epsilon_X))||x||||y||<=5 epsilon_X||x||||y|| for epsilon_X<=1/100. This completes node 1.2 including the product-closeness assertion used later.
